about: One entry per concept of the shipped graph. 'positive' are answer fragments in the style of the captured answers (written from the brain's section content, not from the islands' own teasers) that must light the concept; 'negative' are fragments that look close but must not. 'lights' is the full, reviewed set of places the fragment lights today, in graph order, so a term that starts lighting more is caught too.

positive.text: You pay your ISP, not each app. Apps do not bill you separately; they are paid through the protocol instead.
